# Research sources

Primary/manufacturer references consulted for version 1.1:

- Roland TR-808 Service Manual, hand-clap generating circuit.
- RemArms Model 870 Fieldmaster and Wingmaster product documentation.
- O.F. Mossberg Model 590 product documentation and platform feature notes.
- Winchester Model 1300 and SXP owner's manuals.
- Ithaca Gun Company Model 37 product documentation.
- Benelli Nova product manuals and manufacturer feature articles.
- Robert C. Maher, "Audio forensic interpretation of a shooting incident,"
  AES 153rd Convention, 2022, especially the pump-action waveform and
  spectrogram example.
- Real mechanical-action recordings published by their recordists on
  Freesound, including Winchester 1300 and Remington 870 recordings.

See the accompanying release discussion for clickable source citations.
